name: var_cream_sandstone_side_1
what: the side of a pale cream sandstone. A new variant of the attached texture (the last image before the grid, from my game): exactly the same colours, the same size of grains, flecks and shapes, the same light and contrast; only their arrangement differs, so this tile and the original side by side don't look like a repeat. One even band colour, no darker bands through the middle, the same slightly darker line along the bottom edge; the left and right edges meet so the band runs unbroken along a wall. Seamless on all four edges, every cell filled. Variant 1 of 3: a clearly different layout from the other variants.
